On or before January 1, 2027, natural gas alarms shall be provided and installed in accordance with section 908.13 of the New York city building code.
(L.L. 2016/157, 12/6/2016, eff. 5/1/2019; Am. L.L. 2025/102, 7/30/2025, eff. 7/30/2025)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2016/157.
